description: Read the editor's active log file. Only the active log file is scanned; older rotations (.1/.2/.3) are not included.

file_location.description: Return absolute path of the active log file plus its existence and size in bytes

read.description: Return a filtered tail of the active log file (most recent N entries, in chronological order)

text_search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the full log line

category.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the log category name

since_seconds.description: Only include entries whose [HH:MM:SS] timestamp is within the last N seconds (wall-clock). Lines with unparseable timestamps are skipped when this is set.
